title: 72-attempt limit uses magic number 71 in condition
description: kith-store/src/outbox.rs record_failure() uses the literal 71 in its termination condition (if attempt >= 71, call mark_failed). The number is 0-indexed so attempt=71 means the 72nd failure, but this is non-obvious. A maintainer who wants to change the limit to 100 attempts would need to know to write 99. — Add a named constant MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS: i64 = 72 and rewrite the condition as attempt >= MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS - 1 with a comment explaining 0-indexing.
